user.title: Add a lock

menu_options.cloud: Add a lock via Tuya / Smart Life

user.description: For a new lock, first pair it in the Tuya Smart or Smart Life app. Then choose your Tuya account below to retrieve its pairing details. Daily use in Home Assistant works locally over Bluetooth without the app or Tuya Cloud.

local.title: Import an already-bound lock
local.description: Enter previously obtained Bluetooth pairing details for an already-bound lock. This imports an existing pairing; it does not pair a new or factory-reset lock. The integration stores these pairing details locally and does not contact Tuya Cloud.

select_country.title: Select Country
select_country.description: First pair your lock in the Tuya Smart or Smart Life app. Then select the country used for that account to configure its Tuya Cloud region and country code.

cloud_login.title: Sign in to Tuya
cloud_login.description:
Sign in with the Tuya Smart or Smart Life account your lock is paired to. First we import devices, product types and pairing details and save them locally. Then you choose a lock from the list. The lock does not need to be awake or within Bluetooth range for this step.

Data center: {region}

confirm_new_device.title: Pair the lock with Home Assistant again
confirm_new_device.description:
The lock {name} ({mac}) is not paired. The saved pairing details are complete; whether the lock accepts them is checked during pairing.

Confirm to pair the lock with Home Assistant again. Keep it awake near the Bluetooth adapter or proxy and close the Tuya app. Pairing has not started. You do not need to reset the lock again. The initial Bluetooth response is allowed up to 45 seconds.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Tuya account
reauth_confirm.description: Re-enter your Tuya password for {email}. This also refreshes the pairing details for every stored lock — use this after re-pairing a lock in the Tuya app.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tuya account
reconfigure.description: Enter your Tuya cloud account. Email is prefilled with the current value — change it if you moved to a different account. A hub set up locally will also ask for country and region. Refreshes pairing details for every lock on the hub (use this after re-pairing in the Tuya app).

migrate.title: Migrate the existing integration
migrate.description: Take over the existing Tuya BLE Lock hub. Devices, entity IDs, local pairing details and enrolled credentials are preserved. The old integration is removed. Update automation actions and events from tuya_ble_lock to tuya_ble_access. Back up Home Assistant first.

confirm_local_activation.title: Pair the lock with Home Assistant again
confirm_local_activation.description:
The lock {name} ({mac}) is not paired. The saved pairing details are complete; whether the lock accepts them is checked during pairing.

Confirm to pair the lock with Home Assistant again. Keep it awake near the Bluetooth adapter or proxy and close the Tuya app. Pairing has not started. You do not need to reset the lock again. This attempt uses the saved pairing details without Tuya Cloud. The initial Bluetooth response is allowed up to 45 seconds.

check_device.title: Bluetooth lock found: check pairing details
check_device.description:
Home Assistant receives {name} ({mac}). Discovery does not establish whether the required pairing details are available.

Continue to check locally saved pairing details first. Only if they are missing will we check your configured Tuya account. This step does not pair or reset the lock. Usable pairing details lead to a separate reactivation confirmation.

A new lock without saved pairing details must first be paired in Tuya Smart or Smart Life. Do not reset an already-paired lock to add it to Home Assistant.

manage.title: Add a lock
manage.description: Select a lock from your local registry, or first import all devices, product types and available pairing details from your Tuya account. Bluetooth range is not required for this step.

menu_options.sync_cloud: Import devices and pairing details from Tuya

sync_cloud.title: Import Tuya account
sync_cloud.description: Sign in once to retrieve the device list, matching product types and available pairing details. These are saved locally even when a lock is asleep or out of range. Then choose which lock to add. This step does not activate or reset any lock.

saved_locks.title: Add a saved lock

connection_check.title: Check the lock connection
connection_check.description:
Pairing details for {name} ({mac}) are saved. The connection to this lock has not been checked yet.

Keep the lock near the Bluetooth adapter or proxy and close the Tuya app. This check only reads its pairing state and takes up to about 35 seconds. If it needs pairing again, you will be asked separately.

To continue later, clear the option below. Your details stay saved; no active lock is added yet.

save_account_for_pairing.title: Lock needs to be paired again
save_account_for_pairing.description: The lock {name} reports over Bluetooth that it is not paired. Save the account and pairing details now. Then open Add a lock → Choose a saved lock to continue to the separate pairing confirmation. No active lock has been added. Do not reset it again.

error.auth_key_failed: Could not sign in to Tuya. Check your email, password, country and region.
error.activation_seed_missing: This lock was found in your Tuya account, but its pairing details are incomplete or invalid. Bluetooth activation was not started. Complete pairing in Tuya Smart or Smart Life with the same account and let Home Assistant discover the lock again. Do not factory-reset it to fix missing pairing details.
error.bluetooth_unavailable: The lock is currently unreachable over Bluetooth. Touch its keypad to wake it, keep it near the Bluetooth adapter or proxy, and retry. Pairing details remain saved.
error.device_already_bound: The lock is already paired. Open Add a lock → Choose a saved lock and check its connection to add it. Do not reset it.
error.pairing_failed: Bluetooth pairing could not be completed. Close the Tuya / Smart Life app and disconnect other systems using the lock. Keep the lock awake near the Bluetooth adapter or proxy, then try again. A timeout does not mean a factory reset is needed.
error.bind_verification_failed: Bluetooth pairing completed, but the lock's bound state could not be verified. Keep it awake and nearby, then try again.
error.activation_cloud_fetch_failed: Could not fetch activation data from Tuya cloud. Check the network and account configuration, then try again.
error.activation_storage_unavailable: Local pairing details could not be read or saved. Bluetooth activation was not started. Check Home Assistant storage and try again.
error.activation_credentials_not_saved: The lock may already be bound, but its pairing details could not be saved or loaded after activation. Try again; if the problem continues, reconfigure the integration.
error.activation_failed: Local Bluetooth activation could not be completed. Wake the lock and try again; if the problem continues, reconfigure the integration.
error.integration_changed: The Tuya BLE Access integration changed while this confirmation was open. Start Bluetooth discovery again.
error.invalid_local_credentials: The local pairing details are incomplete or invalid. Check the MAC address, key lengths, hexadecimal values, and 8-digit check code.
error.local_storage_unavailable: The local lock pairing details could not be saved. Try again later.
error.pair_in_app: This device does not have usable pairing details in this Tuya account. Pair it in Tuya Smart or Smart Life with the same account first. Then close the app’s lock panel and wake the lock near Home Assistant for Bluetooth discovery. No Bluetooth activation was attempted.
error.missing_credentials: The hub has no Tuya account login details. Reconfigure the integration.
error.cloud_fetch_failed: Could not fetch device info from Tuya cloud. The lock may not be paired to your Tuya app account.
error.not_a_lock: This Tuya device is not a lock, so it was not added.
error.device_type_unknown: Device type is unknown: Tuya provided no category and no exact known product profile was found. The device was not added.
error.connection_unverified: The connection could not be checked. Pairing details remain saved; no lock was added or paired again. Wake the lock and retry.
error.pairing_data_rejected: The lock reports that it is paired, but its normal connection with the saved pairing details could not be verified. Retry; import updated pairing details from Tuya if needed. Nothing was paired again. Do not reset it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: A Tuya BLE Access hub is already configured. To add another lock, first pair it in Tuya Smart or Smart Life using the hub’s account. Close the app’s lock panel, then wake the lock near a Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter or proxy; Bluetooth discovery adds it to the existing hub. A hub using only local pairing details needs a Tuya account configured for this route.
abort.device_added: Lock added successfully. It will appear shortly.
abort.missing_credentials: The hub has no Tuya account login details. Reconfigure the integration.
abort.cloud_fetch_failed: Could not fetch device info from Tuya cloud. The lock may not be paired to your Tuya app account.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful. Pairing details refreshed for all locks.
abort.local_entry_no_reconfigure: This hub uses local pairing details and has no Tuya Cloud account to reconfigure.
abort.not_a_lock: This Tuya device is not a lock, so it was not added.
abort.legacy_migration_unavailable: Migration requires exactly one enabled Tuya BLE Lock hub with configuration version 2. Update the old integration first and enable the hub.
abort.pair_in_app: This device does not have usable pairing details in this Tuya account. Pair it in Tuya Smart or Smart Life with the same account first. Then close the app’s lock panel and wake the lock near Home Assistant for Bluetooth discovery. No Bluetooth activation was attempted.
abort.activation_seed_missing: This lock was found in your Tuya account, but its pairing details are incomplete or invalid. Bluetooth activation was not started. Complete pairing in Tuya Smart or Smart Life with the same account and let Home Assistant discover the lock again. Do not factory-reset it to fix missing pairing details.
abort.activation_storage_unavailable: Local pairing details could not be read or saved. Bluetooth activation was not started. Check Home Assistant storage and try again.
abort.device_type_unknown: Device type is unknown: Tuya provided no category and no exact known product profile was found. The device was not added.
abort.no_saved_locks: There are no recognized locks left to add in the local registry. Choose Import devices and pairing details from Tuya to populate or refresh it. Unknown types and devices already added remain saved.
abort.pairing_data_saved: Pairing details saved. The connection has not been checked and no active lock was added. Continue later from Add a lock → Choose a saved lock.

activate.name: Activate lock
activate.description: Activate a factory-reset Tuya BLE lock using the configured hub account. Keep the lock awake and in Bluetooth range until activation completes.

address.name: Bluetooth address
address.description: The lock's Bluetooth MAC address or Home Assistant BLE identifier.

device_uuid.name: Device UUID
device_uuid.description: Optional Tuya device UUID when it is known from discovery or cloud data.

name.name: Lock name
name.description: Optional name to store for the activated lock.

add_pin.name: Add PIN code
add_pin.description: Enroll a PIN code on a Tuya BLE lock for a specific member. Home Assistant remembers the code locally for later pause and resume.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock device(s) to add the PIN to.

person.name: Person
person.description: HA person to associate this credential with. Leave empty for a generic member.

pin_code.name: PIN code
pin_code.description: The PIN digits (6-10 digits, numbers only).

admin.name: Admin credential
admin.description: Whether this is an admin credential.

name.name: Label
name.description: Optional label for this access, independent of its person.

add_fingerprint.name: Start fingerprint enrollment
add_fingerprint.description: Begin fingerprint enrollment on a Tuya BLE lock. The user must place their finger on the sensor 6 times when prompted. This is a long-running operation.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this action applies to.

person.name: Person
person.description: HA person to associate this credential with. Leave empty for a generic member.

finger.name: Finger
finger.description: Which finger is being enrolled. Saved separately from the label and shown in the access list.

admin.name: Admin credential
admin.description: Enrol as an administrator credential instead of a normal user. On Tuya locks an admin credential may also open the lock's own management menu (adding/removing users), not just unlock. Leave off for normal users.

name.name: Label
name.description: Optional label for this access, independent of its person.

register_credential.name: Register existing credential
register_credential.description: Associate a credential that already exists in the lock with a Home Assistant person or member. This only stores local attribution metadata; it does not send a command to the lock or contact Tuya Cloud.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this action applies to.

person.name: Person
person.description: Home Assistant person to attribute this credential to.

member_name.name: Member name
member_name.description: Name to use when no Home Assistant person is selected.

cred_type.name: Credential type
cred_type.description: Which kind of credential occupies the hardware slot you are assigning.

hw_id.name: Hardware ID
hw_id.description: Numeric slot ID reported by the lock for this credential.

add_card.name: Start card enrollment
add_card.description: Begin NFC/RFID card enrollment on a Tuya BLE lock. Tap the card on the sensor when prompted.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this action applies to.

person.name: Person
person.description: HA person to associate this credential with. Leave empty for a generic member.

admin.name: Admin credential
admin.description: Enrol as an administrator credential instead of a normal user. On Tuya locks an admin credential may also open the lock's own management menu (adding/removing users), not just unlock. Leave off for normal users.

name.name: Label
name.description: Optional label for this access, independent of its person.

delete_credential.name: Delete credential
delete_credential.description: Delete credentials from a lock. Use person + type to delete by member, or credential_id for a specific credential (from list_credentials).

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this action applies to.

person.name: Person
person.description: Delete credentials belonging to this person.

cred_type.name: Credential type
cred_type.description: Only delete this type (leave empty for all types).

credential_id.name: Credential ID (advanced)
credential_id.description: Delete a specific credential by UUID (from list_credentials service).

list_credentials.name: List credentials
list_credentials.description: List enrolled credentials, current temporary PINs, expired PINs awaiting cleanup and the archived mapping count.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this action applies to.

create_temp_password.name: Create temporary password
create_temp_password.description: Create a time-limited temporary password on the lock (DP 51).

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this action applies to.

name.name: Password name
name.description: Label stored with the temporary password so you can recognise it later.

pin_code.name: PIN digits
pin_code.description: The PIN itself. Digits only, at least 6 of them.

effective_time.name: Start time
effective_time.description: Start time in the configured Home Assistant time zone. An explicit UTC offset or Z is respected.

expiry_time.name: End time
expiry_time.description: End time in the configured Home Assistant time zone. Must follow the start time; an explicit UTC offset or Z is respected.

person.name: Person
person.description: Optional HA person associated with this temporary PIN.

probe_records.name: Probe records (diagnostic)
probe_records.description: Sweep candidate history-read payloads on the lock's "Get Records" DP and report every datapoint the lock sends back. Diagnostic only - used to find the command that replays unlock records after a sleeping-lock unlock.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Lock device ID or MAC address.

dp.name: Datapoint
dp.description: Datapoint to probe. Defaults to 69 ("Get Records").

payloads.name: Payloads
payloads.description: Optional list of raw hex payloads to send instead of the built-in sweep. Each is sent as-is to the datapoint.

collect_seconds.name: Collect seconds
collect_seconds.description: How long to listen after each payload.

report_factory_reset.name: Report hardware factory reset
report_factory_reset.description: Use after you have physically factory-reset this lock. Removes its old PIN, fingerprint, card and other credential mappings, plus temporary password records, from Home Assistant. People and other locks are preserved. Works while the lock is offline. Does not reset the hardware or restore Bluetooth pairing; enroll credentials again after reconnecting the lock.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock you have already factory-reset.

clear_credentials.name: Clear credential store
clear_credentials.description: Empty the Home Assistant credential/attribution store. With a lock selected, clears only that lock's credentials; leave it empty to wipe all credentials and members. This only clears HA-side metadata — it does NOT remove fingerprints or PINs from the lock hardware.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: Limit the clear to one lock. Leave empty to clear everything.

sync_credentials.name: Sync credentials from lock (read-only)
sync_credentials.description: Ask the lock which credential slots are actually occupied (fingerprint, PIN, card) and report them, flagging any the HA store does not know about (orphans left by re-pairs or app-side enrollment). Read-only — nothing is written or deleted.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this action applies to.

clear_fingerprints.name: Clear fingerprints from the lock
clear_fingerprints.description: Delete fingerprints from the LOCK itself and then drop their Home Assistant attribution. Enumerates the lock's real slots first (so orphans left by re-pairs are removed too) and re-reads afterwards to prove what is gone. Leave Hardware ID empty to clear every fingerprint; set it to remove a single slot — do that first to verify on your lock.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this action applies to.

hw_id.name: Hardware ID
hw_id.description: Clear only this slot. Empty clears all fingerprints.

pause_temp_password.name: Pause temporary PIN
pause_temp_password.description: Block a temporary PIN until resumed or its original end time passes. Requires a supported lock and a Bluetooth connection.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The lock this temporary PIN belongs to.

password_id.name: Temporary PIN ID
password_id.description: The password_id returned by create_temp_password or list_credentials.

resume_temp_password.name: Resume temporary PIN
resume_temp_password.description: Restore the original validity without extending the end time or recreating expired codes. Requires a Bluetooth connection.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The lock this temporary PIN belongs to.

password_id.name: Temporary PIN ID
password_id.description: The password_id returned by create_temp_password or list_credentials.

pause_credential.name: Pause credential
pause_credential.description: Pause a supported non-admin PIN, fingerprint or card with an original policy recorded at enrollment. The original expiry stays unchanged.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this action applies to.

credential_id.name: Credential ID
credential_id.description: The credential_id from list_credentials or the Credentials sensor.

pin_code.name: Existing PIN
pin_code.description: Only for ordinary PINs not yet remembered by HA. Enter the same 6–10 digit code once; HA remembers it locally for pause and resume. A different code would change the code on the lock.

resume_credential.name: Resume credential
resume_credential.description: Restore a paused PIN, fingerprint or card to its recorded original validity. Expired credentials cannot be resumed.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this action applies to.

credential_id.name: Credential ID
credential_id.description: The credential_id from list_credentials or the Credentials sensor.

pin_code.name: Existing PIN
pin_code.description: Only for ordinary PINs not yet remembered by HA. Enter the same 6–10 digit code once; HA remembers it locally for pause and resume. A different code would change the code on the lock.

list_access.name: List access
list_access.description: Return the access manager list without PIN digits or protocol properties.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: Optional lock device ID or address. Defaults to the first configured lock.

update_access.name: Edit access details
update_access.description: Edit the label and person without changing the credential on the lock.

device_id.name: Lock device
device_id.description: The lock this access belongs to.

name.name: Label
name.description: A label for this access, independent of its person.

person.name: Person
person.description: Optional HA person. An empty value removes the person association.

device_not_found.message: Device not found: '{device_id}'. Use a MAC address or Home Assistant device ID.

invalid_pin.message: PIN must be at least 6 digits

invalid_hardware_id.message: Hardware ID must be between 1 and 4294967295

service_unsupported.message: The action {service} is not supported by this device profile.

fingerprint_timeout.message: Fingerprint enrollment timed out (no completion in 60s)

card_timeout.message: Card enrollment timed out (no completion in 30s)

sync_failed.message: Credential sync failed for every type: {details}

clear_unsupported.message: This device profile does not support the required sync and delete actions.

activation_unexpected.message: Could not activate lock due to an unexpected error

no_credentials.message: No {cred_type} credentials found for '{member_name}' on this lock

temp_password_no_response.message: No response from lock for temp password creation

query_no_response.message: The lock did not answer the credential query; nothing was deleted. Try again once it is reachable.

fingerprint_not_found.message: The lock reports no fingerprint in slot {slot}

pin_no_response.message: No response from lock during PIN enrollment

fingerprint_enrollment_failed.message: The lock could not complete fingerprint enrollment (code {code}). Try again and follow the prompts on the lock.

cloud_refresh_failed.message: Could not refresh the lock via cloud: {details}

card_already_enrolled.message: The lock reports that this card is already enrolled. Exit card enrollment and test normal unlocking. To associate it in Home Assistant, first identify its existing slot with Sync credentials from lock. No new credential mapping was saved.

card_enrollment_unconfirmed.message: The lock reported enrollment success without a valid card slot. No credential mapping was saved. Read the existing slots with Sync credentials from lock before assigning a person.

temp_password_invalid_time.message: Enter valid start and end times between 1970 and February 2106.

temp_password_nonexistent_time.message: The start or end time does not exist in the Home Assistant time zone because the clock moves forward. Choose another time.

temp_password_ambiguous_time.message: The start or end time occurs twice when the clock moves back. Specify an explicit UTC offset in YAML, such as +02:00 or +01:00.

temp_password_invalid_period.message: The end time must be later than the start time.

temp_password_unconfirmed.message: The lock did not confirm creation with a valid temporary PIN ID. No mapping was saved.

temp_password_rejected.message: The lock rejected the temporary PIN (code {code}: 0x01 failed, 0x02 no free slot, 0x03 PIN already exists). No mapping was saved.

migration_missing_source.message: The source integration for migration is missing. Restore the Home Assistant backup.

migration_unsupported_source.message: Migration requires a Tuya BLE Lock version-2 hub.

migration_unload_failed.message: The previous integration could not be unloaded. Restart Home Assistant to retry.

migration_storage_conflict.message: New-domain storage already contains different data. No existing data has been overwritten.

migration_entity_missing.message: An entity to migrate is missing. Restore the Home Assistant backup.

migration_entity_conflict.message: An entity belongs to an unexpected integration. Migration has stopped.

migration_restart_required.message: Restart Home Assistant to finish domain migration.

local_refresh_failed.message: Could not refresh the lock over Bluetooth. Wake the lock and check the Bluetooth proxy. See the integration debug log for details.

bluetooth_proxy_unavailable.message: The selected Bluetooth proxy is no longer available. Select a current proxy or Automatic.

bluetooth_proxy_unsupported.message: This Home Assistant version cannot enforce a fixed Bluetooth proxy. Use Automatic.

temp_password_not_current.message: This temporary PIN has no unique current hardware ID on this lock.

temp_password_expired.message: This temporary PIN has expired. Resuming does not extend its validity.

temp_password_pause_rejected.message: The lock rejected the change. The pause state is unknown; retry when the lock is reachable.

credential_not_current.message: This credential no longer uniquely identifies a current slot on this lock. Refresh the credential list.

credential_pause_unsupported.message: Pause/resume has not been verified for this credential type and product.

credential_policy_unknown.message: Original validity and device identity are unknown, or this is admin/limited-use access. Pausing requires supported non-admin access with its original policy recorded at enrollment.

credential_expired.message: The original validity has expired. Resuming cannot extend it.

credential_pause_unconfirmed.message: The lock did not confirm the requested change for this credential. Its pause state is unknown; retry when reachable.

credential_pin_required.message: HA does not remember this PIN yet. Enter its existing 6–10 digit code once; HA saves it for pause and resume.

credential_pin_not_applicable.message: Only supply PIN digits for an ordinary PIN credential.

credential_pin_mismatch.message: The supplied code differs from the remembered PIN. Leave the field empty to use the remembered code; pause and resume do not replace it.

access_metadata_invalid.message: Use a label of 1–100 characters and an existing HA person, or leave the person empty.

credential_delete_unconfirmed.message: The lock did not confirm deletion. The registration is retained; check the lock before retrying.

sync_unconfirmed.message: The lock did not return an inventory. Previous registrations are retained.
